rows.title: The transporter list matches DR2.1: its layout, search, columns and shipped transporters
rows.detail: A trader choosing a transporter sees the list laid out as Design Release 2.1 lays it out: a visible 'Select a transporter' sub-heading above the search and the table, the 'Add a transporter' button beside the search rather than below the table, 'Not applicable' where a transporter has no approval number, and a search run from an icon button that also matches a transporter's type and status. With JavaScript the search filters the rows in the page; without it the icon button submits the term and the server filters, so the page still works without JavaScript. The service ships DR2.1's eight transporters (four commercial, four private) with their addresses and approval numbers, replacing the two placeholder commercial records. The list's error and no-match search states are checked for accessibility like its other states.
acceptanceCriteria: The transporter list shows a visible sub-heading 'Select a transporter' above the search box and the transporter table. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/transporter.html:73; trace:prototype-dr2-1 transporter-details-select-a-transporter-from-the-list action 60)

(prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/transporter.html:107-108; trace:prototype-dr2-1 transporter-details-select-a-transporter-from-the-list action 60)

rows.title: Saving an added transporter returns to the list with it chosen and a success banner; cancelling goes to the dashboard
rows.detail: After adding a private or commercial transporter from the journey, the trader goes back to the transporter list, where the new transporter is the first row, already chosen, under a one-time success banner, instead of being sent to the overview. Both add forms gain a 'Cancel and return to dashboard' button that abandons the add and goes wherever the notifications list lives, and keep what the trader typed if a save failed validation and they come back to the form later. Added transporters belong to the organisation, so they stay on its list for later notifications.

rows.title: Find a commercial transporter's Northern Ireland address with an address search
rows.detail: DR2.1 lets a trader adding a commercial transporter search for a Northern Ireland address instead of typing it, and fills the blank address fields from the address chosen. The search calls the same INS backend address lookup as the other address searches and keeps only results whose postcode starts 'BT'. With JavaScript the address and contact fields then start hidden behind the search and an 'Enter address manually' button. The lookup stub gains Northern Ireland addresses so the search and the fill can be seen in the fit suites and on the local stack. All of this is built with address search, once the address lookup is a real feature; until then manual entry stays as it is today.
acceptanceCriteria: In the fit suites, on the local stack and in CDP dev, the commercial transporter form offers an address search labelled 'Search for an address' with the placeholder 'Start typing...' and a search icon button named 'Search', and lists the addresses found under 'Address search results'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-093, prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-094, prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-098; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-127; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-059)

The search offers only Northern Ireland addresses: in the fit suites and on the local stack a search lists the lookup stub's addresses whose postcode starts 'BT' and none of its London addresses; in CDP dev it lists only results whose postcode starts 'BT'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 34-35; repo:stub AddressLookupSimulatorController; conflicts:c-218)

Choosing an address from the results fills address line 1, address line 2, town or city and postcode wherever the trader left the field blank, from what the lookup returns, and leaves the name, the county and every field the trader filled as they were. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-095; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 35; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-060)

With JavaScript the form's address fields and 'Enter contact details' section start hidden behind the address search and an 'Enter address manually' link-style button that reveals them; they already show when an address has been looked up, when address line 1 has a value, when an address field has an error or after any failed save, keeping the search text and the picked address. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-096, prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-097; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-061, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-070; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-128)
Without JavaScript every address and contact field shows from the start, and the form saves from typed values alone. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 35; conflicts:c-006)

sources.ref: claims 34-35: address search is built once the lookup is a real feature; Northern Ireland stub addresses

rows.title: Adding a transporter from the address book
rows.detail: DR2.1 lets a trader add a transporter from the address book through the same 'Choose a transporter type' page and add forms. Started that way, the pages lead back to the address book: the Back link and cancel go there, and saving adds the transporter to the organisation's transporters, held wherever the real services hold transporter records, and shows it at the top of the address book's transporter list.

rows.title: Each transporter on the list links to its details page
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 lets a trader check a transporter's full record before choosing it. Once the real services hold transporter records with a details page, each row of the transporter list ends with a 'View details' link to that transporter's details page, which brings the trader back to the transporter list. The details page lives where the real services hold transporter records, in their conventions, not at the prototype's path; until it exists the list carries no action column.
acceptanceCriteria: Each row of the transporter list ends with a 'View details' link whose visually hidden text names the transporter. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-026; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-089; conflicts:c-052)

Following a transporter's 'View details' opens that transporter's details page, showing its record, and its Back link returns to the same notification's transporter list. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-090, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-047; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-106; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 21)

sources.ref: claims 18, 21: details page in the real services' conventions

notes: Kept apart: it needs transporter records with a details page (the address-book rows it depends on) and the reshaped list (inc-037). Ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 21 lets the real services decide which service owns transporter records and where their details page lives; the row no longer names the prototype's address-book path.

rows.title: The transporter list's buttons when amending a notification or editing a template
rows.detail: When the transporter list is reached while amending a submitted notification, or while editing a template from its review, it ends with the controls DR2.1 gives those modes, so the trader can return to where they came from.
acceptanceCriteria: When the notification is being amended, the transporter list ends with a primary 'Save and return' that goes back to the review, a secondary 'Save and continue' and a link-style 'Save and return to overview'. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/partials/design-release-2.1/journey-form-actions.html isAmend branch; prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-043)

When the transporter list is edited from a template review, it ends with a single 'Save and return' button, which goes back to the template, and a 'Cancel' link back to the template. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/partials/design-release-2.1/journey-form-actions.html isTemplateReview branch; app/routes.js:3335; prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-044)
notes: Combines the two alternative-mode control sets (req-407, req-408): both change only the list's closing controls. Needs amending a notification (inc-004) and editing a template from its review (inc-159) to exist first; the combiner may fold these criteria into those rows if they change the shared save controls for every page at once.

rows.title: A germinal products notification chooses its transporter from its own copy of the transporter step
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1's germinal journey chooses its transporter from the same transporter page as the live-animals journeys. Following the 9 October ruling, the germinal products set gets its own copy of the transporter step, taken from the live-animals set once this programme has built it: the transporter list, 'Choose a transporter type' and both add forms, with the same content, controls and validation, on the germinal journey's own pages. Added transporters belong to the organisation, not to a set, so a germinal notification offers the same transporters as a live-animals one.
acceptanceCriteria: In a germinal products notification, the transport step shows the transporter list with the same caption, heading, 'Select a transporter' sub-heading, search, 'Add a transporter' button, columns and shipped transporters as the live-animals transporter list. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-101, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1-2)

From the germinal transporter list, 'Add a transporter' opens a germinal 'Choose a transporter type' page, and each type opens its germinal add form, with the same copy, buttons and error messages as the live-animals pages, including 'Select a transporter type' for a blank choice and the full blank-form error list on each form. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 2, 13)
Every germinal transporter page is at /germinal-products/notifications/{journeyId}/ followed by the live-animals page's slug. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 1)

Saving a complete transporter on a germinal add form returns to the germinal transporter list with the new transporter first, already chosen, under the success banner; 'Cancel and return to dashboard' goes to the dashboard and adds nothing. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2)

A transporter the organisation added on a live-animals notification is on the transporter list of its next germinal products notification, ready to pick, and one added on a germinal notification is on its next live-animals notification's list. (repo:frontend services/transporters/register.js:24-26)
Picking a transporter on a germinal notification and saving keeps it chosen when the trader returns to the germinal transporter list. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-102)

sources.ref: claims 1, 2, 13: germinal set, pages copied from live-animals feature folders, slugs

notes: New for req-1820, the germinal half the 9 October ruling split from the live transporter step. Depends on the germinal set's foundation row (germinal-products area: 'A germinal products notification starts in its own set, with its own draft, category and origin page'), which the combiner should add to dependsOn, and on every live transporter row it copies (inc-037 to inc-041), so the copy is taken after the live twin is built. It does not copy the commercial address search (inc-042, blocked) or the dead transporters-select page (inc-044). Where the germinal list's Save and continue goes is the germinal flow's, set by the germinal-products area's flow rows.

Belongs with the other germinal feature-folder copies: the combiner should give it the germinal theme those rows sit in, as it touches only the germinal set's transport folder and shares the germinal flow. The shared transporter register is read, not changed, so the live and germinal lists offer the same organisation's transporters.
